bio.text: Vanessa Aronson is the Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 73 on the East Side, according to her campaign website.

According to her campaign website, she most recently served as Senior Director of Strategy at the ASPCA, was previously a New York City public school teacher, and earlier spent a decade as a U.S. Foreign Service Officer.

The site says she previously ran for City Council, is a former president of the Lexington Democratic Club and former Community Board 8 member, holds degrees from the University of Chicago and Harvard, and lives on the Upper East Side.
